prompts.line: Let your hands rest where they are.
How many fingers are held up?
Count these little leaves, slowly.
Blink softly. Let your eyes rest.
How many quiet hellos do you hear?
How many stars can you find?
Count the leaves. Hide them and remember.
Notice one soft color on the screen.
Close your eyes if you like. Count the soft chimes.
Let your shoulders rest comfortably.
Count the fingers, one at a time.
How many leaves are resting here?
Listen for each hello. How many are there?
Let your fingers rest gently.
Count each star just once.
Look at the leaves. How many will you remember?
Notice how your hands feel while they rest.
Look away if you like. How many chimes do you hear?
How many fingers are pointing up?
Make one gentle blink.
Find each leaf. Count at your own pace.
Count the quiet hellos, one by one.
Let your eyes rest for a little moment.
Find the little stars. How many are there?
Remember the leaves. You can peek whenever you like.
Rest your hands. Nothing to finish right now.
Listen to the soft chimes. Count at your own pace.
Try counting these fingers slowly.
Count the leaves. You can take your time.
You can be still for a little moment.
How many times does the voice say hello?
Count the stars, from left to right.
Let your face rest comfortably.
Look, hide, and remember the little leaves.
How many soft chimes can you count?
Your eyes can close whenever they feel ready.
Find each raised finger. How many are there?
How many little leaves do you see?
Let your arms rest comfortably.
Listen quietly. Count each hello.
How many little stars are resting here?
Notice where your hands are resting.
Remember how many leaves you saw. Peeking is okay.
Count the gentle sounds. Then rest if you like.
Let your feet rest where they are.
Pick a soft color on the screen to notice.
You can let your hands be still.
Give your eyes a little quiet rest.
There is no hurry. Stay here for a moment.
You can just rest. That is enough.
